Overview of Aragon Region (Aragon)

Aragon Region (Aragon) is located in the Aragon region of Spain, with its prefectural capital at Zaragoza. Key sights and travel highlights across the prefecture include Casco Histórico & Plaza Mayor, Cathedral & Alcázar, Traditional Mercado Central, Evening Paseo & tapas quarter.

RegionAragon
Capital cityZaragoza
Cities & municipalities12
Primary transport hubZaragoza Central Station (Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail)

How to get to Aragon Region

Connected via Renfe AVE / Avlo / Ouigo / Iryo high-speed rail and ALSA intercity coaches. Use our Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail Fare & Route Calculator and Rail Pass Value Helper to compare rail tickets and regional passes.

Signature local food in Aragon

When visiting cities across Aragon, look out for these regional specialties at station restaurants, markets, and local izakaya:

  • Tapas & raciones
  • Jamón Ibérico de Bellota
  • Tortilla Española
  • Churros con chocolate
  • Regional DO wines

Best time to visit Aragon

Best time to visit Aragon: Apr–Jun, Sep–Nov.
